name: When should I repair moisture-damaged siding versus replacing it entirely?

mainEntity.name: When should I repair moisture-damaged siding versus replacing it entirely?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair or replace moisture-damaged siding depends on the extent of the damage. Minor issues, such as a few warped boards or small areas of rot, can often be repaired by replacing only the affected sections. However, if the damage is widespread, covers a large percentage of your home's exterior, or has compromised the structural integrity behind the siding, a full replacement is usually more cost-effective and provides a longer-lasting solution. A professional assessment can help determine the best course of action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair minor damage, but consider full replacement for widespread issues or compromised structural integrity. A professional assessment is recommended.
